won.source: Not attested in this record; described only as a former North American Champion by the promotion's second pay-per-view of 27 April 1996, by which point he had moved on to a Television title reign and then the World Heavyweight tournament.

note: The record does not say who succeeded him or when directly; by the promotion's Patriot Games pay-per-view of 28 July 1996, Vader is again billed as champion, so the title returned to him at some unattested point in this gap.
